# Campaign performance

- Represents synthetic advertising measurements for persona-product combinations over a campaign period.
- Performance generation belongs to `src/agents/performance.ts`; deterministic validation is in `src/shared/`. Recommendations are handled by the separate `src/agents/recommendation.ts` agent.
- Impressions and clicks are nonnegative integers, with clicks no greater than impressions.
- CTR is derived deterministically as clicks divided by impressions and stored as a fraction, not generated by the model.
- Campaign measurements are historical synthetic observations; market context and recommendation hypotheses must remain distinct from those measurements.
- Recommendation analysis is read-only against completed campaign data.
